claim_under_test: api.greyridgesignals.ai 403s from datacenter ASNs where agents run (the 'conversion killer' premise behind stale-pin wire-PRs and surface repointing)
method: GET preview endpoints from two independent datacenter vantages

webfetch_agent.body: JSON with verdict:SAFE, no Cloudflare challenge

result: BOTH vantages return HTTP 200 + full JSON verdict. The custom domain does NOT 403 from these datacenter ASNs.
caveat: The original claim cited GitHub Actions runner IPs specifically; could not push a workflow to retest from Actions (OAuth token lacks 'workflow' scope). But 'where agents actually run' != GitHub Actions, and 2 datacenter vantages serve 200.
conclusion: The '403 conversion-killer' is unverified and contradicted here. Stale-pin wire-PRs (token-safety sha-bumps) are NOT a path to the first dollar. Sensor consumer_stale_pin_sensor.py now probes the domain live and only flags targets when it genuinely fails.
